title: Roll back inventory when dispatch logging fails
prompt: DispatchLog#append may raise after Dispatcher has reserved inventory. Make Dispatcher#dispatch failure-atomic for that case: restore exactly the quantities reserved for the shipment and re-raise the original append exception. Do not compensate when inventory reservation itself does not complete. Preserve successful dispatch behavior and the public dispatch call, add the smallest supporting Inventory API needed, and add focused tests with a failing log. Assume one local process and do not add concurrency handling.

workflows: compensate only an append failure after successful reservation
invariants: a failed log append leaves inventory as it was before dispatch
a reservation failure is not compensated by Dispatcher
rubric.impact_question: If Inventory and DispatchLog later become separate remote services, why is this local compensation insufficient and where would durable coordination belong?
accepted_alternatives: rescue append failure around a completed reservation and call Inventory#release
use an Inventory reservation object with an explicit rollback operation

runtime_only_if_observed: an over-broad rescue that compensated a reservation failure
evidence that changed the rollback boundary or API
